sources.title: Bellevue Land Use Code 20.20.120 — Accessory dwelling units
sources.supports: Up to two ADUs per lot; 1,200 sq ft cap and director exceptions; 300 sq ft parking/storage exemption; conversions of existing structures; parking rules; home occupation conflict; detached height 24/28 ft; alley lot line siting; amended by Ord. 6931 pending codification.

sources.title: RCW 36.70A.681 — Accessory dwelling units, limitations on local regulation
sources.supports: Two-ADU minimum and configurations; no owner-occupancy requirement; impact fees capped at 50% of principal unit; floor-area floor 1,000 sq ft; 24 ft height floor; alley siting.

sources.title: Washington L&I — Cities that do their own electrical permits and inspections
sources.supports: Lists Bellevue (450 110th Ave NE) among cities issuing their own electrical permits and inspections.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit.com
sources.supports: Shared online permit portal; Bellevue listed among participating jurisdictions.
